subject: Best practices: WP7 batch indexer (queue/state correctness, json_object constraints, cost-aware batching)

items.title: Append-only queue with idempotent consumer
items.rationale: Batch processing must be restartable and safe under retries; idempotency prevents duplicate writes and makes recovery cheap.
items.evidence: Indexer writes artifacts per interaction_id and skips existing semantic blobs; offset advances only after successful processing.
items.action: Keep semantic artifacts keyed by interaction_id and ensure the runner can be called repeatedly without side-effects.

items.title: Never trust byte offsets without newline alignment
items.rationale: A single bug in byte accounting can corrupt cursor state and stall the pipeline silently (0 candidates forever).
items.evidence: Offset drift and mid-line offsets required resync-to-newline recovery; per-line byte lengths were fixed.
items.action: Treat indexer_state.byte_offset as 'start of JSONL line'; implement resync-to-newline self-heal and add logs for offset corrections.

items.title: Validate SDK capabilities against the installed version
items.rationale: Assuming SDK classes exist causes runtime import failures and repeated timer-trigger errors.
items.evidence: ImportError for AppendBlobClient in azure.storage.blob 12.27.1; switching to BlobClient append methods restored compatibility.
items.action: Before using an SDK type, verify it exists in the installed package; prefer stable methods on BlobClient for Azurite/local dev.

items.title: Responses json_object requires 'json' in the input
items.rationale: When prompt enforces json_object output, OpenAI rejects requests unless the word 'json' appears in input messages.
items.evidence: 400 error: "Response input messages must contain the word 'json' ..." until format_hint was added.
items.action: Include a stable hint field (e.g. format_hint='json') in the model input payload when using text.format=json_object.

items.title: Cost-aware batching with hard_min + max_wait
items.rationale: Batching reduces overhead but must not starve low-traffic users; a hard minimum and max wait prevents both waste and starvation.
items.evidence: Thresholds used: target_tokens=1000, hard_min_tokens=600, max_wait_seconds=300, max_items_per_run=25.
items.action: Keep target/hard_min/max_wait configurable and test with 1-2 item batches using backfill to validate the control loop.

items.title: Add a minimal 'signal_level' to steer downstream usage
items.rationale: Downstream systems (session restore/context rebuild) need a lightweight gate to avoid replaying noise (timeouts, retries).
items.evidence: signal_level derived deterministically from confidence when missing; prompt can later set it explicitly.
items.action: Require signal_level low|medium|high in the indexer output and keep a deterministic backend fallback.
